about: Guest information for the free hotel list cards of the boards (js/hotel-list-card.js) and the full list in the phone app (app.html). Facts only: name, street address, phone, website, the logo where an official one reads on the cream column. No prices, no offers. Every field keeps the source it was read from and whether it was verified.
runtime: fids-current/data/hotels/yhz.json is made from this file by scripts/hotels/build-runtime.js: only the hotels that are listed and only the fields the cards and the phone app read. Edit this file, then run the script; tests/hotel-list-cards.test.js holds the two to agree.

rules.areas: downtown = within about 2 km of the centre point; airport = within about 5 km of the airport point; resort = a destination resort (resort true) more than 30 km from both points, listed with its drive distance (no tolerance); nearby = the rest within about 30 km of either point. Each about-limit has a 10 % tolerance; downtown is tested first, then airport.
rules.listed: listed false = held back (the reason is given). A listed hotel is shown only while its season is open (season.year_round, or a season.open range that holds the date at the airport).
rules.shuttle: shuttle.mark true only where the shuttle is verified on the hotel's or the airport's own page.
rules.logo: logo.file is loaded through , never inlined; opaque = the file has its own light ground (shown with a multiply blend on the cream column so the box does not show).
rules.logo_fill: logo.fill true = a stacked lockup whose words are small at the common logo height (62 px at 1680x1050): it may take the whole cell of the cream column, the width of the column and the height of its line. The file is shown as it is.

notes.verified_definition: verified true = read directly on 2026-11-21 on at least one official page: the hotel's own site, its brand property page, the airport's own page (halifaxstanfield.ca) or an official tourism listing (Discover Halifax, the city's destination body; Tourism Nova Scotia, the province's), and no official page read says otherwise. Where only one official page gives a fact, its note says so (one page is enough, as in the Moncton and Charlottetown files). verified false = not read (a page that answered 403 or did not answer), on no official page, or official pages that disagree: the note says which. The airport page's entry for the Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Halifax Airport repeats the Hilton Garden Inn's text and numbers and is not counted for that hotel. OpenStreetMap only found the hotels (scripts/hotels/find-candidates.js) and is cited only beside an official page: no fact rests on it alone. Postal codes take two pages (postal_note).
notes.postal_note: Postal codes are not shown on the cards. A postal code is marked verified true only where two official pages agree. Where the pages disagree (Sandman Signature, Inn on the Lake on Discover Halifax) or only one official page gives one, postal_code is marked verified false.
notes.shuttle_note: shuttle.mark true = the card shows the shuttle mark, only where the airport's own page (halifaxstanfield.ca, Visiting Halifax, Accommodations) or the hotel's own page says so: the Halifax (HFX) Airport Hotel, the Hilton Garden Inn Halifax Airport and Inn on the Lake. shuttle.offered is true / false / null (unknown), shuttle.terms what the page says to do, shuttle.evidence the words read and shuttle.checked the date. The airport page's entry for the Holiday Inn Express repeats the Hilton Garden Inn text, so that hotel is not marked although Tourism Nova Scotia names a shuttle.
notes.season_note: season.year_round true = open all year; season.open would hold the open days (MM-DD to MM-DD) of a seasonal hotel (none in Halifax). season.verified true where Tourism Nova Scotia prints "Open year-round" (read 2026-11-21). Chateau Bedford is on neither listing and its brand page states no season: year_round true there is the city-hotel default, verified false.
sources: Halifax Stanfield International Airport: Visiting Halifax page, Accommodations (halifaxstanfield.ca), read directly
Discover Halifax listings, discoverhalifaxns.com (official destination body; each listing page read directly, ten seconds apart as its robots.txt asks)
Tourism Nova Scotia listings, novascotia.com (official provincial tourism site; each listing page read directly)
Hotels' own sites and the Wyndham and Sandman property pages (read directly); Marriott, Hilton and IHG pages answered 403
OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API (ODbL): credit "© OpenStreetMap contributors". Candidates only (scripts/hotels/find-candidates.js, 2026-11-21), cited only beside an official page

One official page only (verified true, see notes.verified_definition): the Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites Halifax Airport and the Comfort Hotel Bayer's Lake rest on Tourism Nova Scotia alone for their name, street and telephone (their own pages answered 403); the Sandman Signature Dartmouth telephone on its own page; Chateau Bedford on its brand page alone (it is on neither listing).
The airport page lists the Holiday Inn Express Hotel & Suites with the Hilton Garden Inn's text and numbers (a copy error on that page): its telephone and shuttle are not taken from it.
